findings.subject: 111211 BASE - CORNER KEY - BACK - COMMON: M6 x 16 bolts in holes tapped 12 deep
findings.message: The joints register's back corner key (J-BASE-02, section 3.11) takes M6 x 16 ISO 4762 bolts (838001) in M6 holes tapped 12 deep. The fixing bolts reach 16 - 1.6 (washer 838004) - 1.5 (band wall) = 12.9 mm into a 12 mm thread, 0.9 mm too far. The hook studs are set with their heads 1.8 mm off the face, so they reach 16 - 1.8 = 14.2 mm into a 12 mm thread, 2.2 mm too far. A stud bottoms at about 4 mm proud, which leaves the side band's 1.5 mm wall about 2.5 mm of play instead of 0.3. The front and inline keys 111212 to 111214 (geometry HOLD-14) use the same bolts. Calculation from the register's own sizes and ISO 4762 / ISO 7093 (source).
findings.fix: Thread each hole deeper than its bolt reaches. The end-face holes can be tapped through the 20 mm block: the studs reach 14.2, so they don't come out the back. The bottom holes need at least 15 mm of full thread (the block is 60 tall). Or use a shorter bolt there, if the PM allows a second length (D-63 keeps one bolt).

findings.subject: 111211 BASE - CORNER KEY - BACK - COMMON: bolt heads under the band
findings.message: The back corner key's fixing bolts go in from below (J-BASE-02), so their heads sit under the band's bottom face. An ISO 4762 M6 head is 6 mm tall and its ISO 7093 washer 1.6 mm, so 7.6 mm hangs below the band. The band stands on glides with glide_h 10 mm (skeleton P04, assumption), which leaves 2.4 mm to the floor at the nominal setting. Any glide set lower than about 8.6 mm, or a floor high spot near a corner, puts a head within 1 mm of the floor, where the band can rest on it. The front and inline keys use the same bolts. Calculation from ISO 4762, ISO 7093 and the skeleton (source).
findings.fix: Give the heads room: a low-head screw for these bolts (DIN 7984 or ISO 7380, needs a PM ruling because D-63 keeps one bolt), no washer under a flanged head, fixing the key from inside, or a stated minimum glide height with margin in the assembly guide and J-T6.
